property_summary: After depositing d and withdrawing a (2 <= a <= d), a caller must never be able to withdraw more than the remaining balance d-a even if the contract holds extra padding funds; the reference always reverts on the over-withdrawal while the mutant (which decremented the balance by only 1) lets it succeed for a >= 2.
change_summary: Replace `balances[msg.sender] -= amount;` with `balances[msg.sender] -= 1;` so the balance decrement no longer matches the withdrawn amount.
